items.title: Awesome Python
items.content_text:
### Command-line Tools

*   Productivity Tools
    *   [ccb (⭐870)](https://github.com/bfly123/claude_code_bridge) - A CLI tool to orchestrate multiple LLMs (Claude, Gemini, etc.) in Tmux panes with cross-agent interaction.
    *   [cookiecutter (⭐25k)](https://github.com/cookiecutter/cookiecutter) - A command-line utility that creates projects from cookiecutters (project templates).
    *   [copier (⭐3.1k)](https://github.com/copier-org/copier) - A library and command-line utility for rendering projects templates.
    *   [doitlive (⭐3.6k)](https://github.com/sloria/doitlive) - A tool for live presentations in the terminal.
    *   [howdoi (⭐11k)](https://github.com/gleitz/howdoi) - Instant coding answers via the command line.
    *   [invoke (⭐4.7k)](https://github.com/pyinvoke/invoke) - A tool for managing shell-oriented subprocesses and organizing executable Python code into CLI-invokable tasks.
    *   [pathpicker (⭐5.2k)](https://github.com/facebook/PathPicker) - Select files out of bash output.
    *   [thefuck (⭐95k)](https://github.com/nvbn/thefuck) - Correcting your previous console command.
    *   [tmuxp (⭐4.4k)](https://github.com/tmux-python/tmuxp) - A [tmux (⭐41k)](https://github.com/tmux/tmux) session manager.
    *   [try (⭐751)](https://github.com/timofurrer/try) - A dead simple CLI to try out python packages - it's never been easier.

items.title: Awesome Mqtt
items.content_text:
### Brokers

*   [comqtt (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/wind-c/comqtt) - A lightweight, high-performance go mqtt server(v3.0|v3.1.1|v5.0) supporting distributed cluster.
*   [tbmq (⭐700)](https://github.com/thingsboard/tbmq) - Open-source, scalable, fault-tolerant and durable messaging broker for millions of IoT devices.

### Tools

*   [mqtt-studio](https://www.mqttstudio.com) - A practical MQTT Tool with an innovative UI, designed for developers to efficiently create, test, and manage MQTT-based applications, enhancing their development and support workflows.

### Makers / Firmwares for ESP based Devices

*   [HomeGenie Mini](https://homegenie.it/) - Smart device firmware for ESP8266/ESP32 supporting remote monitoring and controlling via MQTT with end-to-end encryption. The firmware is open source and it can be uploaded to the ESP device directly from the website.

### Smart Home Hardware Interfaces / Firmwares for ESP based Devices

*   [amcrest2mqtt (⭐154)](https://github.com/dchesterton/amcrest2mqtt) - Amcrest doorbell to MQTT bridge. Uses Home Assitant's MQTT discovery protocol.

### Smart Home Integration Software / Firmwares for ESP based Devices

*   [HomeGenie](https://homegenie.it/) - Supports remote controlling and monitoring via MQTT with end-to-end encryption.
*   [openLuup (⭐40)](https://github.com/akbooer/openLuup) - A pure-Lua open-source emulation of the Vera Luup home automation environment with MQTT.

### Smart Metering / Firmwares for ESP based Devices

*   [rpi-mqtt-monitor (⭐284)](https://github.com/hjelev/rpi-mqtt-monitor) - The easiest way to track your Raspberry Pi or Ubuntu computer system health and performance in Home Assistant via MQTT.

items.title: Static Analysis
items.content_text:
### Programming Languages / [Other](#other-1)

*   [escomplex (⭐271)](https://github.com/jared-stilwell/escomplex) — Software complexity analysis of JavaScript-family abstract syntax trees.

### Multiple languages / [Other](#other-1)

*   [Seqra](https://seqra.dev) — Security-focused static analyzer for Java and Kotlin web applications. Analyzes bytecode with Semgrep-style YAML rules and CodeQL-grade dataflow (with first-class Spring support) to find vulnerabilities that source-only scanners miss.

items.title: Free for Dev
items.content_text:
### APIs, Data, and ML

*   [Mockerito](https://mockerito.com/) — Free mock REST API service providing realistic data across 9 domains (e-commerce, finance, healthcare, education, recruitment, social media, stock markets, weather, and aviation).
